sira_assessment:
THREAT ACTOR TYPE:
Targeted Attacker

LIKELY INTENT:
Gain persistent root access to the host, pull a Mirai-style payload, then monetise the box as a Monero miner.

TACTICS:
- Reconnaissance sweep of SSH, HTTP and MySQL
- Credential brute force until default root login succeeds
- Ingress tool transfer via wget from a separate payload host
- Resource hijacking - Stratum miner traffic to an external pool

DANGER LEVEL:
CRITICAL - the only actor in the window to achieve a successful login and execute a full kill chain.

RECOMMENDED BLOCK:
YES - confirmed compromise indicators; block the source and the payload host.
